page.overview:
Who is Alexis Wheelson?

Alexis Wheelson is a French vendor living in Paris — part of Pixar.

She is a brown truck who carries tires and hubcaps that she sells to customers. Alexis appears as one of the vendors who offer parts to Finn McMissile, Holley Shiftwell and Mater when they head toward the Marché Aux Pièces.

In Pixar, Alexis Wheelson sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
